name: בְּעֶלְיָדָע
summary: A son of David born in Jerusalem, called בְּעֶלְיָדָע in one list (1Ch 14:7) and אֶלְיָדָע, “God knows”, in the other two (2Sa 5:16; 1Ch 3:8). The parallel shows בַּעַל “lord” in a name standing for God: “the lord knows”, the verb יָדַע. The same use of בַּעַל of Yahweh is what Hosea foretells will end (Hos 2:18).

evidence.note: The same list: “Elishama, וְאֶלְיָדָע, and Eliphelet”: אֵל for בַּעַל.
“You shall no longer call me my Baal.”

note: TIPNR keys David's son as Eliada@2Sa.5.16 with Beeliada as a form. Filed under בעל for the element that distinguishes it; the verb is יָדַע (yada entry). An Eliada name file, if written under אל or ידע, would tag the same person.
